nodes.label: Login Screen Illustration Variant 2 — A flat-style vector illustration (from unDraw by Katerina Limpitsouni) depicting a login/authentication scene. Features a central standing human figure with dark hair rendered in a purple/indigo (#6c63ff) and dark charcoal (#3f3d56) color palette against a light grey (#f2f2f2) circular backdrop. The figure interacts with floating UI elements: an envelope/email card with a purple inbox tray, a password/security card panel, and a mobile device showing a lock-screen interface. Decorative tree/plant shapes with organic leaf forms in grey tones flank the composition. Ground-level floor indicators and subtle shadow planes add depth. The overall style is minimal, geometric, and modern — consistent with the unDraw open-source illustration library aesthetic used for onboarding and login page hero graphics.
nodes.author: Katerina Limpitsouni
